descriptionMarkdown:
This Base is made for BOB's mod version 2.0.x (V2.1 significant changes to receipes and items) for Factorio 2.x (with or without SA) with 10 Books Full of Rails (2.23 or newer) as a Base

Needed MOD's:
- All Bob Mods (not newer than version 2.0.x)
- Wood Circuits Receipe ( https://mods.factorio.com/mod/woodcircuitrecipe )
- Mechanical Inserters ( https://mods.factorio.com/mod/exfret_mechanical_inserter )

10 Books of Rails Website:
https://github.com/Opinionated-Blueprints/10-Books-Full-of-Rails
